title: Admit a registered run's owning_session_id by the session id rule
outcome: Admit a registered run's owning_session_id by the session id rule
acceptance: verification_record admits owning_session_id by the same rule as a session id (at most 64 bytes, the reserved marker refused), or the identifier table documents and a test pins why it differs

blockers.detail: Blocked on TermAl w-decd: its verification_record sender does not exist yet (Architect2 audit #46 on TermAl 972bc08c found no producer). Unblock once that sender exists and TermAl confirms its owning ids are at most 64 bytes. No code until then (Fable #3702).
